name: dependency-observations.valid.p07.engine-pin-as-other
basis: 030 §1 sample 3 (booth.pm/ja/items/7665268) version line '- Unity 2022.3.22f1'. FREEZE RULING (wt-4 batch 166, operator-preauthorized direction): an engine/SDK pin is NOT its own dep_kind — dep_kind='other' (the dependent thing is the runtime/tool) and the version constraint rides version_hint verbatim; version constraints are version_hint's dimension, never dep_kind's.
